# Test fixture notice

The `ocw*` fixture folders contain **metadata only** (JSON and page HTML) taken from
MIT OpenCourseWare course exports, used to test how CourseBox reads their structure:

- 18.657 Mathematics of Machine Learning, Fall 2015 (Prof. Philippe Rigollet)
- 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Spring 2020 (Erik Demaine, Jason Ku, Justin Solomon)
- 6.0001 Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python, Fall 2016 (Dr. Ana Bell, Prof. Eric Grimson, Prof. John Guttag)
- 18.06SC Linear Algebra, Fall 2011 (Prof. Gilbert Strang)

That content is © MIT and licensed under [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)
(see <https://ocw.mit.edu/terms>). It is **not** covered by this repository's MIT license.
No lecture PDFs or videos are included; `files.txt` only lists the names such files would have,
and the e2e suite generates tiny placeholder PDFs in their place.

CourseBox is not affiliated with or endorsed by MIT.
